name: Yvé Dizes
abstract_title: Entangled Meaning: Myth-Making and Symbolic Practice as Relational Consciousness Technology
abstract: As ideological polarization intensifies, individuals increasingly inhabit isolated meaning-systems with little desire or curiosity to expand beyond their immediate concerns. Traditional frameworks, religion, politics, and even modern spirituality often reinforce this fragmentation through extreme individualism: "my truth, my experience, my tribe."
